confusions: The Glossary is twenty screens long and I would never scroll through that to find one word.
Every page is a lot of words before the big numbers, so I kept scrolling past the bits I needed.
The Year by year page only shows one year at a time, so comparing 2015 with 2025 took extra goes and I was not sure how to do it.
The class size and holiday charts are tiny with no numbers on them, so I had to hunt in the small grey writing for the figure.
Top 1% paying 27.2% and the household 33.6% sit near each other and I nearly mixed them up.
I could not find anything on manufacturing jobs, the maximum infant class size or most visited country, so I gave up on those.
Several tap links near the top of a page are tiny words in a sentence, and the Back to top button covered some of the text.
The G7 comparison page was a table with ranks I had to read across, and one row was hidden behind the Back to top button.
